BiblicalUsage: A burden is what Moses could not bear alone and what God grows weary of bearing. Moses asks how he can bear the cumbrance and burden and strife of the people, and the Lord says their appointed feasts are a trouble to Him, and He is weary to bear them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the burden cuts both ways: the people's burden wearies Moses, and the people's worship wearies God when it is only form.
